title: Aphorism § 209
text:
§ 209



 After this is done, the physician should endeavor in repeated
          conversations with the patient to trace the picture of his disease as completely as
          possible, according to the directions given above, in order to be able to elucidate the
          most striking and peculiar (characteristic) symptoms, in accordance with which he selects
          the first antipsoric or other remedy having the greatest symptomatic resemblance, for the
          commencement of the treatment, and so forth.
